limitations: Search - all pairs a <= b < 300, 4000 random pairs below 10^6, literature and Historian examples, c < 300 for an explicit triple; 'no failure found' does not prove associativity. Tribonacci s = 4 and s = 5 are open in the sources read (the Historian derives s >= 5 from AFMP's bound on fractional digits and Messaoudi's Thm 2, unchecked).
novelty_basis: Partial - the tribonacci and 4-bonacci bounds are in the literature (Messaoudi 2000, 2002; AFMP 2003); the other values are the lab's measurements.
proof_check: lower bounds certified by explicit triples (results/EXP-C08-06.json); upper bounds proved only where the literature proves them (Fibonacci s >= 2 Lean; Pell s >= 1 Messaoudi 2000 Thm 1; tribonacci s >= 6 per Messaoudi 2002 as reported by Ambroz-Masakova-Pelantova 2007, s >= 9 GPTW; 4-bonacci s >= 10 Messaoudi 2000 Remark 2)
title: Corrected associativity thresholds - certified lower bounds and searched ranges
